extension.name: System - Nicode Web Monitor
extension.author: Nicolau Roca
extension.license: GNU General Public License version 2 or later
extension.description: HTTPS inventory, backups and locally prepared plugin updates. Maintenance requires separate credentials and private storage. Development only.

field.name: site_id
field.label: Site UUID
field.description: Unique UUID v4 for this installation. Keep it when rotating credentials; change it on clones.

field.name: token_hash
field.label: Credential SHA-256 digest
field.description: 64 lowercase hex characters. Never paste the bearer credential here. Empty revokes access immediately.

field.name: backup_token_hash
field.label: Backup credential SHA-256 digest
field.description: Separate from inventory. Empty disables backups. Never paste the credential itself.

field.name: backup_storage
field.label: Private backup directory
field.description: Absolute directory outside every web root, restricted to the service account. Pre-create operations and snapshots subdirectories. See backup-http.txt before enabling.

field.name: update_token_hash
field.label: Update credential SHA-256 digest
field.description: Must differ from inventory and backup. Empty disables updates.

field.name: update_storage
field.label: Private update directory
field.description: Locally vetted packages and operation permits. Outside all web roots. See extension-update-http.txt.
